The podsips-search skill is a legitimate integration for the PodSips API, allowing an AI agent to search podcast transcripts and metadata. It uses standard curl and jq commands to interact with api.podsips.com and requires a user-provided PODSIPS_API_KEY. The instructions in SKILL.md and references/api-guide.md are well-documented, align with the stated purpose, and show no signs of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or prompt injection.
